scripts.api:generate: npm run build --workspace @insight/contracts && npm run build --workspace @insight/server && node scripts/generate-api.mjs
scripts.api:check: npm run build --workspace @insight/contracts && npm run build --workspace @insight/server && node scripts/generate-api.mjs --check
scripts.format: prettier --check .github apps packages scripts test docs/api docs/operations README.md package.json playwright.config.mjs tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts test playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @insight/contracts && npm run build --workspace @insight/server && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @insight/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @insight/contracts && npm run build --workspace @insight/server && node --test test/database.integration.mjs
scripts.db:migration:head: npm run build --workspace @insight/server && node .tsbuild/server/database/cli.js status
